import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

print("=" * 60)
print("RUSSIAN TEXT NORMALIZATION SOLUTION - FIXED (NO DATA LEAKAGE)")
print("=" * 60)

# Load data
print("\n[1/6] Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train: {len(train):,} rows")
print(f"Test: {len(test):,} rows")

# Create ID columns
train["id"] = train["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + train["token_id"].astype(str)
test["id"] = test["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test["token_id"].astype(str)

# Remove duplicates
print("\n[2/6] Cleaning duplicates...")
train = train.drop_duplicates(
    subset=["before", "sentence_id", "token_id"], keep="first"
)
train = train.reset_index(drop=True)
print(f"After dedup: {len(train):,} rows")

# Hold out validation set FIRST (before building any mappings)
print("\n[3/6] Creating validation split...")
np.random.seed(42)
n_val = int(len(train) * 0.1)
val_indices = np.random.choice(len(train), size=n_val, replace=False)
validation = train.iloc[val_indices].reset_index(drop=True)
train_final = train.drop(train.index[val_indices])
train_final = train_final.reset_index(drop=True)
print(f"Training: {len(train_final):,} rows")
print(f"Validation: {len(validation):,} rows")

# Build exact match lookup dictionary FROM TRAINING ONLY (no validation data leakage)
print("\n[4/6] Building exact match lookup (train-only)...")
before_after_map = {}
for _, row in train_final.iterrows():
    before = str(row["before"])
    after = str(row["after"])
    before_after_map[before] = after

print(f"Unique before tokens in training: {len(before_after_map):,}")


# Simple fallback: for unseen tokens, try common patterns or keep original
def get_normalized(before_text, lookup):
    before_text = str(before_text)
    # Direct lookup first
    if before_text in lookup:
        return lookup[before_text]
    return before_text  # Fallback: keep original for unseen


# Process validation
print("\n[5/6] Evaluating validation set...")
validation_predictions = []
for _, row in validation.iterrows():
    before = str(row["before"])
    target = str(row["after"])
    pred = get_normalized(before, before_after_map)
    validation_predictions.append(pred)

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

val_accuracy = accuracy_score(
    [str(row["after"]) for _, row in validation.iterrows()], validation_predictions
)
print(f"Validation Accuracy (LEAKAGE-FREE): {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Process test data
print("\n[6/6] Generating test predictions...")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
test_predictions = []
test_before_list = test["before"].astype(str).tolist()

for before_text in test_before_list:
    pred = get_normalized(before_text, before_after_map)
    test_predictions.append(pred)

submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"].tolist(), "after": test_predictions})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {len(submission):,} rows")

# Save validation results for reference
val_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"id": validation["id"].tolist(), "after": validation_predictions}
)
val_df.to_csv("./submission/validation_results.csv", index=False)

# Print summary
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("FINAL RESULTS")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Validation Accuracy (hold-out): {val_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"Submission file: ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission):,}")
print(f"Unique predictions: {len(set(test_predictions))}")
plan: The validation contamination occurs because the lookup dictionary is built from all training data before the validation split is created, meaning validation targets are already in the mapping. I will restructure the code to first split the data into train and validation sets, then build the lookup dictionary only from the training portion, ensuring the validation metric is a genuine out-of-sample estimate.
